uncertainties.block_walkability_and_construction_volum: Eight-block samples cannot prove collision clearance, exact grades, road earthwork or tree-removal volume.
uncertainties.cave_mouths_ravines_natural_bridges: Section-palette presence cannot locate entrances, tunnels, overhangs or bridge geometry.
uncertainties.conservative_graph: Dry samples and rise-limited edges can miss traversable rough ground, bridges, boats and caves; disconnected is not physically impossible. Buildability is not a hard Wilderness travel gate.
uncertainties.destination_detection: 8-block dry-bank, highland-boundary, forest-boundary, slope-foot, coast and persistent biome-interface samples; not verified passes, valleys, saddles, junctions, sightlines or fords.
uncertainties.destination_search: Bounded 32-block corridor neighborhood, 40–150 effective-depth candidate envelope, top 3 per feature then 12 per Route. These are prototype search restrictions, not balance or exhaustive global optimality.
uncertainties.destination_semantics: Opportunity means access to observed geography only; no resources, rewards, ecology or gameplay role inferred.
uncertainties.destination_tuning: Normalized additive costs and joint duplicate/overlap weights are explicit uncalibrated prototype assumptions. No measured early-game utility is available.
uncertainties.formation_semantics: Surface masks establish geographic candidates, not verified valleys, passes, saddles, landmark prominence or human-perceived interest.
uncertainties.human_review: No human A.2 candidate selection or player-scale validation is supplied by this fitter.
uncertainties.physical_network_connectivity: Finite surface costs include water opportunities; inferred joins and reachable bands do not prove block-level traversability or grade-separated intersections.
uncertainties.resource_equivalence: No ore, food, animal, crop or full homeland resource portfolios in the committed grid.
uncertainties.settlement_access: Existing village piece bounding boxes only; projected sampled edge is not a verified village entrance or occupied settlement. Other structures are not treated as settlements.
uncertainties.travel_time_hunger_and_level_access: Effective blocks are an explicit analytical cost, not measured time, Hunger expenditure or level gates.
uncertainties.true_chokepoints: Surface clearance proxies cannot establish mandatory chokepoints with caves, boats and player modification available.
